aruba_central_raw.dataset_description: Aruba Central is a cloud-based HPE Aruba Networking platform for managing and monitoring network infrastructure.

gid.field_description: The ID of the Aruba Central device group associated with the audited action.

classification.field_description: The category of the audited action recorded in Aruba Central.

description.field_description: The message describing the Aruba Central audited action or networking event.

id.field_description: The ID of the audit record in Aruba Central.

ip_addr.field_description: The IP address from which the audited action in Aruba Central was performed.

target.field_description: The serial number of the device the Aruba Central audited action was performed on.

user.field_description: The user who performed the audited action in Aruba Central.

event_type.field_description: The event type of the Aruba Central record.

event_uuid.field_description: The unique ID of the networking event within Aruba Central.

level.field_description: The severity level Aruba Central assigns to the networking event.

client_mac.field_description: The MAC address of the client device involved in the networking event.

group_name.field_description: The Aruba Central configuration group of the reporting network device.

hostname.field_description: The host name of the network device that reported the event to Aruba Central.

bssid.field_description: The BSSID of the access point radio involved in the wireless networking event.

device_mac.field_description: The MAC address of the network device that reported the event to Aruba Central.

device_serial.field_description: The serial number of the network device that reported the event to Aruba Central.

device_type.field_description: The type of device involved in the Aruba Central event.

ts.field_description: The time the audited action was recorded in Aruba Central, in epoch seconds.

timestamp.field_description: The time the networking event occurred in Aruba Central, in epoch milliseconds.
